translation_snapshot.source:
Strike an adjacent target with a mighty blow from the forge, inflicting %d%% weapon damage.  If the attack hits, the echo of the attack will lash out at all enemies in a %d radius of the impact.
		Learning this talent adds %0.2f mind damage and %0.2f burning damage to your Dream Hammer strikes.
		The mind and fire damage will scale with your Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
用梦之巨锤对近身目标挥出强力的一击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。如果攻击命中，挥击所产生的回音会伤害 %d 码范围内的所有目标。
		学习此技能会使你的梦之巨锤附加 %0.2f 精神伤害和 %0.2f 燃烧伤害。
		受精神强度影响，梦之巨锤附加的精神伤害和燃烧伤害按比例加成。

translation_snapshot.source: A heavy shirt of scale mail constructed from the remains of Kroltar, whose armour was like tenfold shields.
translation_snapshot.target: 一件用库洛塔的遗物打造的重甲，她的护甲有盾牌的十倍重。

translation_snapshot.source:
Your mastery over magic is so great that you can alter the energy of all damaging spells to suit your needs.
		Whenever you deal damage with a spell you attune to the element of that spell for 6 turns, converting %d%% of any damage you deal into that element.
		This effect will not override itself and will only trigger from spells directly cast by you, not from damage over time or ground damage effects.
translation_snapshot.target:
你对魔法的掌握是如此精巧，你可以调节任何伤害技能的能量，来为你所用。
		每当你使用法术造成伤害的时候，你将法术调谐到这一元素，持续 6 回合，你造成的所有伤害中的 %d%% 将会转化为该元素。
		这一效果不会覆盖自身，只会被你直接释放的技能触发，不会因持续伤害或地面伤害效果而触发。
